issues.feedback: In `ralph auto`, `SPEC.md` is removed right after project creation. A 2-second poll loop can miss it entirely, so this does not reliably meet 'post immediately after generation'. Use a durable signal/path or a guaranteed final scan before teardown.

The spec assumes a single match for `.ralph/quick-prd/*/SPEC.md` and `.ralph/projects/*/prompt-original.md`, but `.ralph` is preserved across retries. Stale artifacts can cause wrong or old content to be posted. Add per-run scoping (timestamp/mtime/run-id/known project path).

Using `prompt-original.md` as the trigger is not completion-safe. It is written before prompt overwrite and before review artifact write; failures in between can produce incorrect 'Final Prompt' comments. Trigger on a post-review completion signal (e.g., `prompt-review.md` or equivalent).

Watcher cleanup is only described for `collect_children`, but children are also removed in abort/force-kill paths. Missing cancellation/join there can leak watcher tasks and race with worktree cleanup.

'Immediately' is not defined in a testable way. Add explicit timing/ordering guarantees (for example, before terminal completion handling or within a bounded latency) and define expected behavior when artifacts already exist on retry.

The plan is missing validate conformance coverage and key scenarios: `--skip-prompt-review`, `run --project` retry path (no quick-prd generation), stale pre-existing artifacts, and ordering/timing assertions proving comments are not deferred to pipeline end.

Posting full `SPEC.md`/`prompt.md` may exceed GitHub issue comment limits; current posting helper is best-effort and may silently fail to satisfy acceptance criteria. Specify truncation/chunking/failure behavior.
